law: Every material hypothesis, freeze, implementation choice, execution receipt, counterexample, post-result lemma and next-step decision must be preserved as a new event; prior events are never rewritten.

events.statement: MK_ID and MK_FUTURE are different objects; distinct exact states may be deliberately merged when their correctness-relevant authorized futures are equivalent.
Absolute minimality is removed from the theorem core. Polynomial size, discovery, verification, update and semantic sufficiency are the relevant obligations.
The central local law is K(T_a(S)) = U_a(K(S)) for every authorized typed transition a.

R0 uses four global Boolean variables, all width-1/2 one-or-two-clause seeds, exact reachable closure under ASSIGN and EXISTS, and three frozen key languages: structural candidate, truth oracle control and fixed-order ROBDD candidate.
